dedupe_keys.name: underlying and extended data for flexibility aware clustering of residential electricity consumption for demand response targeting using high resolution smart meter data

description: Nickie Gkolia, Nikos Dimitropoulos and Vangelis Marinakis at the National Technical University of Athens publish derived residential load-profile and demand-response analysis data. The archive contains daily profiles, assignments from Dynamic Time Warping, Euclidean and flexibility-aware clustering, flexibility indicators, targeting outputs, statistical checks and cluster-count sensitivity results. The September 2026 release is free under CC BY 4.0. It derives from the separately published PLEGMA dataset and explicitly excludes the original household measurements. Household count, observation period and geographic coverage are not repeated in this deposit's description. The derived profiles can support demand-response targeting and flexibility simulations, while conclusions remain conditional on the source sample and clustering choices. Separate analysis software is linked through Zenodo. No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this derived release. The referenced Scientific Data article describes the upstream PLEGMA data and is not treated as this derivative's describing paper. The companion results README warns that summed fifteen-minute mean-power values require multiplication by 0.25 hours to express absolute delta_load in watt-hours.
